name: Temporal observability of intraoperative hypotension with an emulated 5-minute blood pressure display: reproducibility package
description: Analysis code, configuration templates, reproducibility manifests, figure source data, editable scientific figures, the final workbook and non-identifiable aggregate results for a retrospective waveform study of intermittent blood pressure display. Version 1.5.0 retains the original analyses and adds the completed rule-based startup signal-quality sensitivities, consolidated supplementary-table presentation and current artwork. Independent physician clinical adjudication was not performed. The emulation describes displayed information on fixed recorded arterial trajectories and does not estimate monitoring-related treatment delay or patient-outcome benefit. This release assembly does not rerun source-data analyses. Raw VitalDB, MoVeR and INSPIRE datasets and case-level derivatives are not redistributed.
